Method of Attack: Keylogging via leftover debugging code in Synaptics Touchpad driver, enabled by setting a registry value to activate logging of scan codes to a WPP trace
Impacted Systems: HP notebook models including HP 25*, mt**, 15*, OMEN, ENVY, Pavilion, Stream, ZBook, EliteBook, ProBook series, and several Compaq models
Attack Vector: Enabling a registry key (HKLM\Software\Synaptics\%ProductName% and HKLM\Software\Synaptics\%ProductName%\Default) to activate keylogging, requiring bypass of UAC prompt
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of keylogging code in SynTP.sys file, registry keys HKLM\Software\Synaptics\%ProductName% and HKLM\Software\Synaptics\%ProductName%\Default
